project_type: Monorepo - React SPA (Vite) web app + Expo React Native mobile app
build_system: Bun for package management and runtime. Vite for web frontend bundling.
test_framework: Vitest for web app integration tests (tests/api.test.js)
verification_instructions: 1. bun run lint (in apps/web) - 0 errors. 2. bun run typecheck (in apps/web) - 0 errors. 3. bun run build (in apps/web) - success. 4. bun run test (in apps/web) - pass. 5. Backend server starts without errors (bun run start in apps/server).
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN - can fetch from vidapi.ru for testing. Bun runtime available. Use Bun everywhere (NOT npm, NOT yarn).
contribution_requirements: Use Bun for all package management. All lint/typecheck/build/test must pass. No direct vidapi.ru calls from frontend.
key_patterns: Components in src/components/ use functional React with hooks. Pages in src/app/ use react-query for data fetching. API utility in src/utils/api.js centralizes all API calls. Tailwind CSS for styling. react-router-dom for routing. Lucide-react for icons. vercel.json has rewrites for SPA + API proxy. wrangler.toml + functions/ for Cloudflare Pages proxy. render.yaml for Render deployment.
directory_structure: HIJISTREAM/ (root) -> apps/web/ (React SPA with Vite), apps/mobile/ (Expo React Native), .github/workflows/ (CI/CD). Web app: src/app/ (pages), src/components/ (UI), src/utils/ (api, cache, storage, player), src/hooks/ (keyboard shortcuts), tests/ (vitest). Deployment configs: vercel.json, wrangler.toml, render.yaml.
